high_level_description: This image captures a charming street scene in Lisbon, Portugal, as indicated by the text overlay. The photograph is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the vintage tram that is the focal point of the image. The tram, painted in a classic yellow with white trim, is labeled "28" on its front, suggesting it's part of Lisbon's iconic electric tram system. The tram is positioned on a narrow street lined with historic buildings. These buildings exhibit ornate architectural details, typical of Lisbon's Baroque and Neoclassical styles.
